name: Bullish Engulfing
description: A two-candle bullish reversal pattern. The first candle is bearish and the second candle is a larger bullish candle whose real body completely engulfs the real body of the first candle. Signals a decisive shift from selling to buying pressure.

body_rules.candle_1: bearish (red/black) real body of any size
body_rules.candle_2: bullish (green/white) real body that opens at or below candle 1 close and closes at or above candle 1 open
body_rules.engulfment: candle 2 body must fully contain candle 1 body; the larger candle 2 body is relative to candle 1, the stronger the signal

wick_rules.candle_1_wicks: not relevant to the pattern definition
wick_rules.candle_2_wicks: ideally small; large wicks on candle 2 reduce conviction
wick_rules.engulfment_wicks: body-to-body engulfment is the primary rule; wick-to-wick engulfment is an even stronger version

context_requirement: must appear at the end of a downtrend or at a key support level; engulfing patterns in ranging markets or mid-trend are less reliable
volume_requirement: candle 2 volume should be significantly higher than candle 1 volume; this confirms the surge in buying pressure
agent_rules: Confirm the pattern is at a support zone, trendline, or significant Fibonacci level
Enter long at the open of candle 3 or after candle 2 closes
Stop loss below the low of candle 2 (or the pattern low)
The larger candle 2 is relative to candle 1, the stronger the reversal signal
High volume on candle 2 is a critical confirmation factor
An engulfing pattern that also engulfs the wicks of candle 1 is considered stronger
Avoid trading this pattern after a very small candle 1 (a tiny bearish candle is easily engulfed and may not signal enough prior selling)
